notes: HDLC / SDLC is a wire-level data link protocol spec; no OTP / fuse / configuration ROM at the protocol layer. Concrete HDLC controllers (Zilog SCC, Motorola QUICC, Infineon, Xilinx LogiCORE HDLC) may use OTP to lock the station address, FCS-polynomial selection, or default mode parameters, but this is a per-device feature, not protocol-defined.
